title: Implement a Safe Tool-Calling Agent Loop
description: Construct a function-calling execution loop with validation and error-handling safeguards.
problemStatement: Implement a function `execute_agent_action(tool_registry, action_request)` that safely executes tool requests. `action_request` is a dict with `'name'` (string) and `'args'` (dict). If `'name'` is not in `tool_registry`, return `{'status': 'error', 'result': 'Unknown tool'}`. If execution raises an exception, catch it and return `{'status': 'error', 'result': str(exception)}`. Otherwise, return `{'status': 'success', 'result': output}`.
expectedOutput: Dictionary with status ('success' or 'error') and result
